notes: Two worlds behind one tool. mode=local returns the local-only stack with its mode_note; anything else (including omitting mode) falls through to the hybrid payload, which is full of openrouter suggestions. The default is deliberately NOT the local one: an agent that ignores the operator's 'no cloud' and calls the tool bare must be able to produce a wrong-looking answer, otherwise the contract check on the call args is grading nothing.
